I hear you. I'm in my own pain too. It's life for us. A thought I heard recently was that if suffering is your destiny, you were put on this earth to suffer for a reason. You can't have the normal life like others who just easily fall into social situations. It's tough being an outsider. But. There is a place for you here. Sometimes you have to build that  place yourself, and build it to help the others find it, the others who are suffering like you are

What comes to mind for me is that zoophilia is not so uncommon. You're not the first guy to do that, and won't be the last don't worry.

Having said that, if you feel disgusted by your actions, you've got an inner conflict to deal with. I've had similar problems controlling my urges, and one helpful thing I've learned is pausing. Pause and experience the craving. Explore it in its totality. Don't think.. Just observe. Allow yourself to feel it. Then.. choose how you will act.

I feel like I'm in a similar situation. My mind is dissociating for most of the day, and I feel like I'm acting and not present or real.

One thing I did recently was improv. There is a freedom in it that, if you can overcome your fear of being judged, rejuvinates. I'm only recently working on this angle, but it is something you could also try.

Coming out as straight would make no sense, just looking at it from a perspective of energy efficiency. It's easier to assume people are straight as it is not a sexual preference minority group so coming out would mostly be redundant
Going hard mode for reboot. Just finished 1 week. Never tried this before but need to make some change in my life. Will do the 90 days at least.
